It is possible for poisoned hugetlb pages to reside on the free lists.
The huge page allocation routines which dequeue entries from the free
lists make a point of avoiding poisoned pages.  There is no such check
and avoidance in the demote code path.
If a hugetlb page on the is on a free list
column2: poison will only be set in

column1: the head page rather then the page with the actual error.  If such a
page is demoted
column2: then the poison flag may follow the wrong page.  A page

column1: without error could have poison set
column2: and a page with poison could not

column1: have the flag set.
Check for poison before attempting to demote a hugetlb page.  Also
return -EBUSY to the caller if only poisoned pages are on the free list.
